title: CHELSA-BIOCLIM+ v2.1 January near-surface mean-temperature climatology
publisher: Swiss Federal Institute for Forest, Snow and Landscape Research WSL
scope: One global 1981-2010 January near-surface mean-temperature CHELSA-BIOCLIM+ v2.1 NetCDF raster, plus official metadata, CC0 license evidence, and DOI-hosted technical/version evidence.
limitations: This snapshot contains only January mean temperature and cannot alone provide a complete annual climate forcing or canonical climate layer.
CHELSA-BIOCLIM+ is a land-surface climate product; ocean climate and atmosphere coupling require separate cited evidence.
The source grid is a downscaled climatology at its published resolution, not a direct measurement at every simulation location or time.
No artifact in this snapshot is exposed to agents or accepted directly as a canonical world-data bundle.
